authorities.name: T Choithram International SA v Pagarani
authorities.court: Privy Council (on appeal from British Virgin Islands)
authorities.date_note: The decision date is UNVERIFIED to this precision - it comes from a BAILII page-title search snippet, not an independently fetched primary source, and is recorded here with that caveat rather than omitted.
authorities.proposition: An effective gift, or an implied declaration of trust, can sometimes be found by benevolent construction of a donor's words and actions - a recognised exception to the general rule that equity will not perfect an imperfect gift, applicable where the donor's intention was an immediate, irrevocable disposition.
authorities.authority_weight_note: Privy Council decisions are persuasive, not binding, in England & Wales courts - see docs/OPERATING_RULES.md's authority hierarchy.
authorities.verification_note: Not read directly - BAILII blocked (HTTP 403), block treated as final. Quoted within Curtis v Pulbrook [2011] EWHC 167 (Ch) (below), fetched live.

authorities.name: Curtis v Pulbrook
authorities.date_note: Year only confirmed via the citation itself; exact date not independently verified this session.
authorities.proposition: Cites Choithram, via Arden LJ's earlier analysis in Pennington v Waine, as authority for the benevolent-construction exception, treating it as good law eleven years on with no doubt cast.

edges.verified_via: Curtis v Pulbrook [2011] EWHC 167 (Ch), fetched directly from Find Case Law: cites and applies Choithram.

what_this_is_not: One verified node-pair confirming Choithram remains good law as of 2011. Does not independently confirm Choithram's original 2000 text or exact decision date - see verification_note and date_note above. Pennington v Waine is mentioned within the fetched Curtis v Pulbrook text but was not itself independently fetched, so it is not included here as a separate node.
